scope.purpose: diagnose whether v2.1 native qualification measured host-tool trajectory stability instead of intervention-relevant evidence opportunity stability

analysis_units.task_correctness: frozen outer-harness correctness only; used as a descriptive stratum and never to select evidence
analysis_units.host_tool_path: the v2.1 ordered sequence of tool family, executable kind, candidate relation, and success semantics
analysis_units.evidence_opportunity: a successful model-visible acquisition result whose request-derived subject, query, or structural intent is compatible with a frozen evidence family
analysis_units.intervention_compatible_carrier: an evidence opportunity with a deterministic structural carrier potentially routable to R1, S1, or B1 without oracle or answer-derived selectors
analysis_units.candidate_identity: the v2.1 exact family/request-shape identity retained only as the historical comparator

read_like.required_relation: request-derived subject path or request anchor

search_like.required_relation: request-derived query term and bounded subject scope

structured_bash_like.required_relation: request-derived command intent and reliably parsed structural output

classification_rules.MEASUREMENT_UNKNOWN: required private artifact is missing, malformed, censored, or cannot be linked deterministically
classification_rules.NO_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE: the run is correct but has no successful request-related external evidence opportunity
classification_rules.IDENTITY_FALSE_NEGATIVE: v2.1 candidate_recurred is false while exactly one request-related compatible carrier is present
classification_rules.TOOL_SELECTION_VARIANCE: runs use more than one host carrier for the same evidence family while retaining request-related evidence opportunities
classification_rules.TRAJECTORY_ONLY_VARIANCE: request-related carrier identity is stable but the full v2.1 host path signature varies
classification_rules.GENUINE_EVIDENCE_INSTABILITY: request-related intervention-compatible evidence opportunity is absent or non-unique too often to meet the frozen descriptive 8-of-10 reference level
classification_rules.STABLE_INTERVENTION_COMPATIBLE_CARRIER: a request-related compatible carrier recurs at the frozen descriptive 8-of-10 reference level without ambiguity
classification_rules.INSUFFICIENT_DIAGNOSTIC_EVIDENCE: the observed prefix cannot distinguish the registered causes

metrics.evidence_opportunity_recurrence: runs with exactly one request-related evidence opportunity / completed runs
metrics.compatible_carrier_recurrence: runs with exactly one intervention-compatible carrier / completed runs
metrics.path_entropy_bits: Shannon entropy over v2.1 path signatures using log2
metrics.normalized_path_entropy: path_entropy_bits / log2(number of completed runs), or 0 when completed runs <= 1

privacy.public_values: aggregate counts, normalized carrier labels, reason codes, and digests only
